description: 기상청_국내 공항기상정보 조회서비스 [airports] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 기상청. 국내공항의 날씨(요약, 일기개황, 최저/최고기온, 낮 최고 체감기온, 예상 강수량, 예상 적설량, 위험 기상예보, 경보현황)을 조회 공항기상정보는 항공기의 안전한 이착륙·운항을 위해. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 기상청. Its tags are 공항, 기상, 국내, 항공기, 일기개황. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2025-09-17 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
